title: Three Months and One Short Stamp
subtitle: 国家公民 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 国家公民（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）
meta: 主题语境：国家公民（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）　|　核心词汇：socialism　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 socialism 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1994 the clerk ① studyed the socialism that no applicant in the office would have described, and he said the studying was the whole of the month. The ② socialism, meaning the system itself and not the stamp, ran three months and stayed undescribed in the book; socialism, he said, is the only thing in an office that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ sort of socialism in that office had the same short stamp beside it, and the ④ socialism at the far counter, meaning the form they kept for the children to sign and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Socialism, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the clerk said the describing is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the socialism was the whole of the matter, meaning the belief and not the system. The ⑥ socialism, meaning the belief and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; socialism, he said, is either something you study or the only word that means both system and a belief. He said the belief is the part they remember.

By 1999 the ⑦ socialism had become a line in a file, and the file had become an argument about the short stamp. The ⑧ socialism of the whole thing, the clerk wrote in May, was one office and three months of describing; socialism, he said, is either the form at the far counter or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ socialism I remember is the socialism described in the file, which closed in 2001 and is still described as the quietest in the office. ⑩ Socialism, my mother said in 2003, is the only thing that improves by being described; all socialism, she said, is a belief that has agreed to look like system. She said the belief was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 社会主义（指办事处里每一类旁边的那一类）
B. n. 社会主义（指那种社会主义本身，与小小的印章相对）
C. 固定搭配：study the socialism 研习这一种社会主义
D. n. 社会主义（指留给孩子们签的那一份）
E. n. 社会主义之事（抽象总称，指一处办事处的社会主义之事）
F. n. 社会主义（指卷宗里写到、被描述的那一种）
G. n. 社会主义、信念（指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 信念（抽象总称，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: studyed the socialism that no applicant in the office would have described
The socialism, meaning the system itself and not the stamp
Every sort of socialism in that office
the socialism at the far counter
the socialism was the whole of the matter
the socialism had become a line in a file
The socialism of the whole thing

answers.why: study the socialism 意为“研习这一种社会主义”，1994 年那位书记员把办事处里没有一位申请人肯描述的一种社会主义做了一遍。
socialism 意为“社会主义”，指那种社会主义本身而不是小小的印章，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被描述。
socialism 意为“社会主义”，指办事处里每一类旁边的那一类，每一类旁边都有同一枚小小的印章。
socialism 意为“社会主义”，指最远那个窗口的留给孩子们签的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
socialism 意为“社会主义、信念”，指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这种信念就是那件事的全部。
socialism 意为“信念”，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西而不是那种社会主义，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
socialism 意为“社会主义”，指卷宗里写到、被描述的那一种，到 1999 年这一种成了卷宗里的一行。
socialism 意为“社会主义之事”，书记员五月写道，整件事的社会主义之事是一处办事处和三个月份的描述。
socialism 意为“社会主义”，我记得的是卷宗里描述过的那一种，2001 年办结了，至今仍被说成办事处里最安静的一种。
socialism 为抽象总称，母亲 2003 年说，社会主义是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的社会主义。
